normal_packet_directed.scope: Simulation-only ordinary-result/younger exact-packet independent bus overlap under legal consumer backpressure.

limits: Reference is the optimized reduction design before timing retiming, not unmodified upstream Ara.
Cycle measurements do not establish execution time at a measured clock frequency.
Directed legal backpressure test proves concurrency correctness, not production performance benefit.
